label: Garland 1G/10G Aggregating TAP (P10GSFPA)
description: Garland AggregatorTAP Fiber P10GSFPA - portable passive TAP with four SFP+ cages at 1G/10G, DIP-switch selectable modes (breakout, aggregation, regeneration, bypass), metal chassis, four units per 1U rack shelf, two AC power supplies included.
notes: Four SFP+ cages, and the mode is a DIP switch rather than software: breakout (two independent taps), aggregation (both directions into one monitoring port), regeneration/SPAN, bypass. The spec models the **aggregation** wiring - netA/netB in, copies out monA/monB - because that is what the four cages are for in the default configuration; breakout would be two taps in one shell and a graph would have to draw it as two nodes. It is a passive TAP: no management, no capabilities, and nothing learned. Two AC supplies ship with it, which is redundancy, not PoE - nothing here powers a peer.
